data.label: Loss of Hydraulic Pressure
data.description: Illustrative loss of required hydraulic supply through both pump paths, controller failure, or electrical power loss. Basic-event probabilities are separate teaching inputs, not calibrated aircraft failure probabilities.

data.label: Loss of Function
data.description: Either failure mode causes the top event

data.label: Unsafe Ordered Failure
data.description: Protection must fail before the demand occurs

assumptions: Independent Bernoulli inspections; 1 means defective, 0 means good.
Stop at the first crossing; later supplied observations are ignored and counted.
OC and average sample number use the declared horizon and terminal rule.
